comments.author: 66325452@N02
comments.text:
There use to be a place in the Bailey Range (Olympics) that had pristine layering such as this, and very reflective and colorful... it was beautiful.

Back in the very early 70's it was still intact except for a couple main game trails that all animals seemed to use. Then the area got on people's lists of places to see and the area went through a transformation as the delicate rock patterns were broken, some percentage of the new hikers straying off the game trails and went walking across the pristine rock in unthinking fashion. I was, and am, very sorry to to have seen that happen.

comments.author: 100330886@N04
comments.text: I just looked up the Bailey Range and this mountain is just to the East of that.  I'm looking forward to exploring more in the Olympics.  It's too bad about the patterns getting worn.
